name: Linen Chenille Barrel Swivel Accent Chair
summary: A linen chenille barrel accent chair with a 360° swivel base, solid wood frame, and high-density foam. It ships fully assembled and is rated to support up to 350 lb.
highlights: Solid wood frame with a wood-supported movable back cushion
Linen chenille upholstery and high-density foam
Sinuous springs and reinforced elastic webbing; supports up to 350 lb
